name: Macfree Softgel 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About MACFREE SOFTGEL

Macfree Softgel is a nutritional supplement used to manage vitamins and mineral deficiency, as well as to promote general wellbeing of an individual. It contains multivitamins, multiminerals, antioxdiants and omega-3 fatty acids as active ingredients to promote general health and boosts immunity.

Alpha lipoic acid is a powerful antioxidant which protects the cell damage from free radicals. Lutein is an important dietary carotenoid that accumulates in the macular eye region which is necessary for the vision. It is a potent antioxidant that reduces the damage of eyes due to free radicals. Omega-3 fatty acids contains the two major components namely, docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) and eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA) which reduces inflammation, regulates blood clots, promotes brain and heart health.

Vitamins are a group of substances that are needed for normal cell function, growth and development. It also requires for the body to work properly, resist infections and helps to get energy from the food.

Minerals are essential for the body to stay healthy. Also, it helps the bone, muscles, heart and brain to work properly and plays an important role in the production of enzymes and hormones.

Always take Macfree Softgel as advised by the doctor. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water and do not chew or open the contents of the medicine. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Do not take this medicine if you are allergic to any of its components.
author: Dr. R. Dinesh John Rajkumar

name: Rudimin Drops 30ml
brand: Brio Bliss Life Science Pvt Ltd
introduction:
Introduction About RUDIMIN DROPS

Rudimin drops is a Nutritional supplement that is used to manage vitamin deficiency in children. It contains Multivitamins such as Vitamin A palmitate, Vitamin E acetate, Vitamin D3, Thiamine hydrochloride, Pyridoxine hydrochloride, Riboflavin, Niacinamide, L-Lysine monohydrochloride, Zinc as active ingredients that helps to meet up nutritional requirements for children and promote their growth and development.

Multivitamins help to maintain normal nutritional requirement and functioning of the body as well as boosts immunity. Vitamin A helps to improve the vision, immunity, bone health, growth and development in children.

B vitamins like Thiamine, Niacinamide, Riboflavin, Pyridoxine aids in proper nerve functioning as well as maintains energy levels. Vitamin D3 promotes bone health, teeth health and muscle development.

Vitamin E is an antioxidants that helps to protect cells from free radical damage. Lysine is an amino acid that acts as a building block for production of protein and makes children active.

Always give Rudimin drops to your child exactly as advised by your doctor. Shake well before use. Give 1 ml of Rudimin drops daily after feed to infants under 1 year of age. For children above 1 year of age, give 2 ml of Rudimin drops daily after meal or as directed by your child’s physician. Do not exceed the stated recommended dosages.
author: Dr. Priyanka Goel

introduction:
Introduction About SKYFIZ SUGAR FREE EFFERVESCENT TABLET

SKYFIZ SUGAR FREE Effervescent Tablet is a dietary supplement that brightens your skin and improves skin complexion and texture. It also boosts immunity which helps in management of seasonal infections like cold, flu, cough, etc. It contains powerful antioxidant agents like Vitamin C, Kiwi seed extract, and Mulberry extract as active ingredients.

They help in reducing hyperpigmentation and suntan, fade away dark spots, evens your skin tone and makes your skin look brighter and more radiant. They also boost collagen production in the body which tightens your skin and manages wrinkles and fine lines. Additionally, vitamin C also boosts immunity and increases iron absorption in the body.

Take one SKYFIZ SUGAR FREE Effervescent Tablet daily or as advised by your physician. Drop one tablet in 200ml of water. Wait until the tablet dissolves completely and consume the drink immediately. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Before taking SKYFIZ SUGAR FREE Effervescent Tablet inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding or having any pre-existing disease conditions as a precaution.
